description: This PHP source file defines the LoginHistory class, which manages recording, retrieving, and displaying user login history information in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for logging login and logout events, generating list views, and checking login status.

classes.name: LoginHistory
classes.description: Manages storing and displaying login history of users, including recording login/logout events and retrieving login history records.

methods.name: LoginHistory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger and database instances.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewHeader
methods.description: Returns header labels for login history list view.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves login history entries for a specified user, with pagination support.

methods.name: user_login
methods.description: Records a user login event with username, ip, and login time.

methods.name: user_logout
methods.description: Records a user logout event, updating the most recent login record with logout time and status.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Creates a SQL query to fetch login history records with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: firstTimeLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user has logged in for the first time within a specified delay window.
